concept: DynamoDB: hot partition from a low-cardinality key
tests: Diagnosing throttling despite sufficient total capacity: traffic skewed to a few partitions due to a poor partition key.
expected: Cause: hot partition (low-cardinality country_code key); fix: a high-cardinality key (user_id), plus write sharding with a suffix if needed. Triggers: "throttling even though capacity is sufficient", "most traffic comes from two key values".
why_not: Adding RCU does not help — the bottleneck is a single partition; a GSI on the same skewed attribute keeps the skew; read consistency is unrelated to partition distribution.
